table.retrieve:
Select
	icode,
	customicode,
	name,
	Packunits,
	usercode,
	lastupdate,
	StockInHand = dbo.Fn_GetItemStockInGodowns(icode, (Select Min(gcode) From Godown) , (Select Max(gcode) From Godown) ) ,
	PurQty = dbo.Fn_GetItemPurQtyWRTDate(icode, :adt_startdate, :adt_enddate),
	PurReturnQty = dbo.Fn_GetItemPurReturnQtyWRTDate(icode, :adt_startdate, :adt_enddate),
	SoldQty = dbo.Fn_GetItemSoldQtyWRTDate(icode, :adt_startdate, :adt_enddate),
	ReturnQty = dbo.Fn_GetItemReturnQtyWRTDate(icode, :adt_startdate, :adt_enddate),
	MinQty,
	ReOrderQty,
	OptimumQty,
	ChangeReason,
	Module
From
	Item
Where
	Active=1 AND
	Item.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode)  and
	Item.ICatCode IN (:ai_icatcode)  and
	Item.ICCode	 IN (:ai_iccode)    and
	Item.PackCode IN (:ai_packcode)

objects.name: c_avgqty
objects.expression: IF( ISNull( c_netqty / (DaysAfter( Date(adt_startdate), Date(adt_enddate) ) + 1) ), 0, c_netqty / (DaysAfter(Date(adt_startdate), Date(adt_enddate) ) + 1) )
